FaqPage.section1A1: Opstap is a tool that automatically applies for you. You upload your CV or fill in your profile, choose jobs on the largest Dutch job boards and Opstap writes a personal cover letter per job. You approve, we send.
FaqPage.section1Q2: How do I create an account?
FaqPage.section1A2: Go to opstapapp.nl, click "Get started" and register with email or via Google, Outlook or Meta. You can start immediately once your account is created.
FaqPage.section1Q3: Do I need to upload a CV?
FaqPage.section1A3: No, that's optional. You can also fill in your profile manually. If you upload a CV, we store it encrypted and use the information to write better letters.
FaqPage.section2A1: Yes. Every letter is generated based on the specific job and your profile. Opstap is built on recruiter experience: the AI knows which tone, length and content suits which type of company, and what hiring managers do and don't want to read.
FaqPage.section2Q2: What makes Opstap better than ChatGPT?
FaqPage.section2A2: ChatGPT writes a correct text, but a hiring manager immediately recognises it as AI output. Opstap letters are built on years of recruitment experience: concrete connection between your background and the job, no generic openers, and tailored to the company type. Always editable before you send.
FaqPage.section2Q3: Can I edit a letter before it's sent?
FaqPage.section2A3: Always. You approve every letter and can fully edit it before anything is sent. Nothing goes out without your approval.
FaqPage.section2Q4: In what language are the letters written?
FaqPage.section2A4: By default in Dutch. Opstap is focused on the Dutch job market.
FaqPage.section3Q1: What happens to my CV and personal data?
FaqPage.section3A1: Your data is stored encrypted on EU servers. We share nothing with third parties and do not use your data for AI training. You decide how long we keep your CV (default 30 days). You can delete everything at any time.
FaqPage.section3A2: Yes. We ask for explicit consent before you upload a CV, store all data within the EU and offer you the right of access and deletion. Every automated decision (such as the letter AI writes) is always visible and editable by you.
FaqPage.section3Q3: How do I delete my account and data?
FaqPage.section3A3: Go to Settings → Delete account. All data is immediately and permanently deleted, including your CV and application history.
FaqPage.section4A1: You start free. When you sign up you immediately get some free credits, enough to experience how it works. When your credits run out, we'll show you exactly what it costs to continue. No surprise upfront, no subscription.
FaqPage.section4Q2: How does the credits system work?
FaqPage.section4A2: 1 credit = 1 cover letter. You only use credits when you have a letter generated. When your credits run out, you see options to top up. Credits never expire.
FaqPage.section4A3: No. You only pay for what you use, when you need it. No monthly costs, no hidden costs. You can top up via iDEAL.

OverOnsPage.pageTitle: About Opstap | More chances. Less effort.
OverOnsPage.pageDescription: Opstap is built by an experienced recruiter who knows what hiring managers really look for. Read our story.
OverOnsPage.section1Para1: Opstap grew out of frustration - the healthy kind. We saw every day how well-qualified candidates missed out. Not because they weren't good enough, but because they didn't present themselves well enough. A cover letter that was too generic. An application that came just a little too late. A job they'd never seen.
OverOnsPage.section1Para2: At the same time we saw how time-consuming job searching is. Every job requires a separate letter, adapted to the role, the company and the hiring manager. That's tens of hours of work for every serious search.
OverOnsPage.section2Para1: There are plenty of tools that use AI to write cover letters. The problem: they produce generic texts that hiring managers immediately recognise as AI output. They sound correct, but they don't convince.
OverOnsPage.section2Para2: At Opstap, the AI is built on years of recruitment experience. We know what hiring managers look for, what they immediately put down and what they keep reading. Those insights are baked into every letter Opstap writes.
OverOnsPage.featureItem1: No opening sentence that starts with "I am writing to apply"
OverOnsPage.featureItem2: Concrete connection between your experience and the job
OverOnsPage.featureItem3: Tone and length tailored to the company type
OverOnsPage.section3Heading: Built for the Dutch job market
OverOnsPage.section3Para1: Opstap searches the largest Dutch job boards: Indeed, LinkedIn, Jobbird and Nationale Vacaturebank. All letters are in Dutch, tailored to the Dutch recruiter and the Dutch job market.
OverOnsPage.ctaSubtext: Create an account and apply to multiple jobs today.
OverOnsPage.legalText: Opstap processes personal data in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). All data is stored on EU servers. You always have the right to access, correct and delete your data. You can permanently delete your account and all associated data via Settings. Opstap does not share personal data with third parties for commercial purposes and does not use your data for training AI models. More information:

PrivacyPage.section1Body: Opstap is a job application automation service, developed and managed in the Netherlands. You can reach us via our contact form or via privacy@opstapapp.nl.
PrivacyPage.section2Intro: We only process data that you provide to us yourself:
PrivacyPage.section2Item1Detail: email address and password (stored encrypted via Supabase Auth)
PrivacyPage.section2Item2Detail: name, location, desired position, availability, hours per week, work location
PrivacyPage.section2Item3Detail: PDF or Word file that you upload (optional)
PrivacyPage.section2Item4Detail: the AI-generated cover letters you send
PrivacyPage.section2Item5Detail: time of last activity (for automatic deletion after 90 days inactivity)
PrivacyPage.section3Title: 3. What do we use your data for?
PrivacyPage.tableRow1Doel: Search for jobs on Dutch job boards
PrivacyPage.tableRow5Doel: Reminder email for CV expiry date
PrivacyPage.section4Title: 4. How long do we keep your data?
PrivacyPage.section4CvItem: CV file: you choose the retention period when uploading: 7, 30 or 90 days. You receive an email 7 days before the expiry date. The file is automatically deleted on the expiry date, unless you extend the period.
PrivacyPage.section4ProfileItem: Profile data and applications: until you delete your account, or after 90 consecutive days of inactivity (automatic deletion).
PrivacyPage.section4AccountItem: Account data: until you delete your account.
PrivacyPage.section4DeleteNote: You can delete your CV or your entire account at any time via Settings → Delete CV or Delete account. Deletion is permanent and immediate.
PrivacyPage.section5Title: 5. Do we share your data with third parties?
PrivacyPage.section5NotShared: We do not share your data with third parties for commercial purposes.
PrivacyPage.section5ProcessorsIntro: We use the following processors, solely for the performance of the service:
PrivacyPage.processorRow2Doel: Generating cover letters (temporary processing, no storage)
PrivacyPage.processorRow4Doel: Product analytics, only after your consent via the cookie banner
PrivacyPage.section5AnthropicNote: Anthropic's Claude API temporarily processes your CV content and job text to generate a cover letter. Anthropic does not use this data for training AI models (Enterprise API terms).
PrivacyPage.section5ContactNote: Questions about the specific storage of your data? Email privacy@opstapapp.nl.
PrivacyPage.section6Item1: All data is stored encrypted (AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit)
PrivacyPage.section6Item2: CV files are stored in a private Supabase Storage bucket, only accessible with your JWT
PrivacyPage.section6Item3: Row-Level Security (RLS) ensures you can only view your own data
PrivacyPage.section6Item4: Passwords are stored hashed via Supabase Auth (bcrypt)
PrivacyPage.section7Right1Detail: (art. 15): you can always view your profile data and applications in the app
PrivacyPage.section7Right2Detail: (art. 16): you can adjust your data via Edit profile
PrivacyPage.section7Right3Detail: (art. 17): you can permanently delete your CV or entire account via Settings
PrivacyPage.section7Right4Detail: (art. 21): you can object to processing based on legitimate interest
PrivacyPage.section7Right6Detail: you have the right to lodge a complaint with the Dutch Data Protection Authority (autoriteitpersoonsgegevens.nl)
PrivacyPage.section7ContactNote: For exercising rights not automatically available in the app: privacy@opstapapp.nl. We respond within 30 days.
PrivacyPage.section8NoCookies: Opstap does not use advertising cookies or commercial trackers. We do not use Google Analytics or similar advertising services.
PrivacyPage.section8PostHog: We use PostHog for product analytics, solely to understand how the app is used (e.g. which features are popular), so we can improve the service. PostHog stores data in the EU (Frankfurt).
PrivacyPage.section8CookieItem1: Analytics are only activated after you explicitly give consent via the cookie notice at the bottom of the page
PrivacyPage.section8CookieItem3: PostHog never receives your CV content, cover letters or personal data from your profile. Only anonymous usage events (pages visited, buttons clicked) are shared
PrivacyPage.section8CookieItem4: You can withdraw your consent at any time by recalling the cookie notice or clearing your browser data
PrivacyPage.section9Body: The AI generates cover letters based on your profile and the job text. This is a supporting function: you always see the letter before it is sent and can edit or reject it. No legally or otherwise significant decisions are made solely on the basis of automated processing.
PrivacyPage.section10Body: If we change this policy, we will notify you by email and in the app. The date of the last change is at the top of this document.
PrivacyPage.section11Intro: For questions about privacy or exercising your rights:

VoorwaardenPage.section1Body: Opstap is a service that helps job seekers in the Netherlands find jobs and create cover letters using artificial intelligence. By using Opstap you agree to these terms.
VoorwaardenPage.section2Body: You are responsible for the security of your account and password. Use Opstap only for legitimate job application purposes. Misuse, including sending spam or applying for jobs you are not seriously considering, is not permitted and may result in your account being blocked.
VoorwaardenPage.section3Body: You may use Opstap for personal, non-commercial use. It is not permitted to automate the service beyond the offered functionality, resell the service or make it available to third parties.
VoorwaardenPage.section4Body: The AI-generated cover letters are a tool. You are responsible for the content of all applications you send. Opstap is not liable for the consequences of submitted applications.
VoorwaardenPage.section5Body: We strive for high availability but give no guarantees. We may modify, extend or terminate the service. In case of termination you will receive timely notice and the opportunity to export your data.
VoorwaardenPage.section6BodyPrefix: How we handle your personal data is described in our
VoorwaardenPage.section6BodySuffix: , which forms part of these terms.
VoorwaardenPage.section7Body: Opstap is not liable for indirect or consequential damages arising from use of the service. Our liability is in all cases limited to the amount you have paid for the service in the past three months.
VoorwaardenPage.section8Body: We may update these terms from time to time. We will announce material changes by email or a notice in the app, at least 14 days in advance.
VoorwaardenPage.section9Body: These terms are governed by Dutch law. Disputes will be submitted to the competent court in the Netherlands.

InvitePage.pageDescription: Opstap helps you automatically apply to Dutch jobs. Personal letters, multiple jobs at once.
InvitePage.heroBody1: Job hunting takes a lot of time and energy. Opstap takes most of that off your plate - so you can focus on the jobs that really matter.
InvitePage.heroBody2: You've been invited to try it for free. Quick to set up, and sending your first applications literally takes minutes.
InvitePage.step1Body: Upload your CV or fill in your profile. Opstap remembers your experience, education and preferences so you never have to fill that in twice.
InvitePage.step2Body: We search for you on Indeed, LinkedIn, Jobbird and more. You browse the results and tap what appeals to you.
InvitePage.step3Body: For every job, Opstap writes a personal letter in Dutch. You read it, adjust what you want, and give the green light.
InvitePage.step4Title: We send, you wait for good news
InvitePage.step4Body: Opstap sends your application by email or via the company's web form. No more hassle - just wait for an invitation.
InvitePage.ctaBody: Create an account and your first application will be on its way before you know it.
InvitePage.ctaPrivacyNote: Your data stays on EU servers and is never shared.
